messages:
alicia.support: Hey team, incoming escalation from a midsize customer — embedding API to hosted inference returning 502/504 intermittently starting ~03:20 UTC. They report ~30% failures for 1-2min bursts, then recovery. Reported trace ids: tx-8b3f, tx-8b40. They can repro on CURL and our SDK. Posting curl and sample response below.

alicia.support: curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input":"test"}' 
response: HTTP/2 502
{"error":"upstream_conn_reset","trace_id":"tx-8b3f"}

ben.sre: Looking at LB metrics now. Seeing concurrent 502 spikes from edge -> auth-proxy upstream at 03:19:50 - 03:21:10 UTC. Envoy upstream_rq_retry and 5xx counters climb. 95th p50 latency for auth-proxy spiked from 40ms -> 800ms.

chen.runtime: Can you paste the upstream hostnames? If it's auth-proxy we recently rolled a small change to keepalive.

ben.sre: Upstreams: auth-proxy-v2.prod.internal:10000, embed-service-v3:11000. Auth-proxy is showing connection queueing and RSTs.

alicia.support: Customer says errors happen across regions (us-west/us-east). They tried pinning to us-east but still intermittent. They saw more failures during heavy embedding batches (~64k tokens payload).

dave.eng: Hmm batching + large payloads could cause h2 stream/window pressure on the edge. We rolled a keepalive tweak last week — maybe connection pool sizing regressed. I'll pull the deployment that touched envoy/ingress.

incidentbot: Deploy 2026-03-17T02:38:10Z -> ingress/edge-service: keepalive-tweak-3 applied to canary (1/3 hosts).

chen.runtime: That matches. Canary looks like it got 20% of traffic and errored under burst. Could be h2 stream saturation -> envoy RSTs -> 502s. Repro plan: run a stress job that sends 100 concurrent streaming embedding requests with realistic chunking.

ben.sre: I ran a quick probe from synthetic runner: ramped to 150 concurrent streams with 512k payloads and saw upstream RSTs and Envoy log: 
"upstream reset: connection failure, reason: connection termination, trace_id=tx-8b3f"

alicia.support: Customer is asking for an immediate mitigation — they want traffic flowing. Any quick fixes we can put in place?

dave.eng: Short-term: rollback keepalive-tweak-3 from ingress canary to stop pool exhaustion. Mid-term: increase h2 concurrent streams and tune per-connection window for embed endpoints. Also add backpressure/reject fast for oversized batch requests.

chen.runtime: I agree. I'll initiate rollback now and add a temporary rate-cap at the edge for embedding route to limit concurrent streams per connection to 50.

ben.sre: Pushing rollback to canary now. Watch metrics for 2 minutes.

incidentbot: Rollback started: ingress/edge-service keepalive-tweak-3 -> previous (2026-03-10)..

alicia.support: Noted. I told customer we're rolling a rollback and implementing a quick cap. They asked for the exact ETA.

chen.runtime: ETA ~5-7 minutes to see canary health shift and <1min after that for error rate to drop if root cause is keepalive.

ben.sre: Metrics: errors down from 30% -> 4% at 03:26 UTC. Partial recovery but still seeing tail. Some fragments of 502 tied to embed-service response latency.

dave.eng: Looks like two contributing factors: 1) ingress keepalive change causing connection pooling collapse, 2) embed service slow processing for large batches causing head-of-line blocking. We'll open a follow-up to limit batch size and add streaming chunking guidance in docs.

alicia.support: Customer confirms drop to ~2% failures after rollback. They're satisfied with mitigation but asked for permanent fix and root cause write-up.

carla.pm: I'll own the post-mortem and customer write-up. Action items: (a) revert keepalive tweak in production fully, (b) add per-route concurrent stream caps, (c) add batch-size guardrails + SDK chunking example, (d) embed-service perf investigation for large payloads.

dave.eng: Adding (e) add Envoy metrics alert for upstream RSTs > 5% over 1m and (f) run synthetic test with large-embedding workload in staging.

ben.sre: Logged incident ticket INC-2026-0458 and linked customer case CASE-8892. Will post final timeline after post-mortem.

alicia.support: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer thread and set expectation for post-mortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark: 

carla.pm: Assigning follow-ups: dave.eng (keepalive full rollback + caps), chen.runtime (rate cap + synthetic test), ben.sre (alerts + ticket notes), alicia.support (customer comms).

alicia.support: Closing this Slack thread once post-mortem doc is ready.
